observations.code_quote: return False, "That handle or DID couldn't be found on Bluesky. Check the spelling and try again."
observations.behavior: Adds a normalize_actor helper to strip leading '@' from actor handles before API calls; also catches 400 responses with non-JSON bodies and returns an actionable message instead of failing.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent credential validation failures for users who copy-paste Bluesky handles including the '@', potentially reducing support requests related to import configuration.
